why: v0.1.0-beta.3 to beta.8 were cut from feature branches before the fast-forward rule (2026-10-10) and name commits main does not contain. v0.1.7 was landed by a rebase merge on 2026-10-26 before this gate existed: the tag names db1c0ba4, whose tree equals main's 5d67f19. The list may only shrink and no new entry is accepted against the base ref. v0.1.0, v0.1.0-beta.9 and v0.1.1 join the diverged list on 2026-11-01: the public repository's history begins at the 2026-10-22 export, so those three tags name pre-export commits that the trunk it publishes from never carried. Every later tag from v0.1.3 on sits on public/main.
not_a_release_why: These refs exist in one clone and were never tags of bemlerlabs/ephe — `git ls-remote --tags public` does not list them. They carry another lineage's subjects and dates (v1.0.0 2026-05-04, v4.1.0 2026-09-12) and were made before Ephe's version scheme. `git tag` lists what a checkout holds, so on this machine the gate would judge them and report a divergence in a release line that never contained them. Recorded, printed per ref, and a name that carries no tag here is said out loud.
